title: Reuse the canonical preference facade for browser settings surfaces
summary: Browser settings for LLM selection should wrap getLlmSelectionSnapshot/saveLlmSelectionPreferences (validation against policy candidates included) rather than writing .env.local or separate state. The catalog/service surfaces mirror the pattern: expose governed read models and defer mutations to the existing propose/approve flow.
